description: A benign soft fibroepithelial polyp commonly called a skin tag.

appearance.general: Soft flesh-coloured or slightly darker pedunculated papules or nodules may occur.

warning_signs: A rapidly changing, bleeding, or painful lesion should be assessed rather than assumed to be a skin tag.
